name: Arcana
description: Use Arcana's suite of portfolio intelligence tools through a natural language interface. Analyze real-time portfolio and single stock analytics. Attribute performance across names, factors, and custom groups. Workflows built for analysts, PMs, risk managers, CIOs, and allocators. Just ask about your portfolio to get started: "How is [book name] performing YTD"

_published_faq.name: How do I add Arcana to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Arcana to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://app.arcana.io/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Arcana MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Arcana lists 34 MCP tools, including apply_config_to_portfolio, compute_sensitivity_matrix, get_all_asset_contribution_tab_ids, get_all_asset_drilldown_tab_ids, get_all_portfolio_drilldown_tab_ids, get_all_risk_factor_categories, get_all_risk_models, get_asset_contribution_data, get_asset_decomp_timeseries, get_asset_drilldown_data, get_asset_metric_snapshots_batch, and get_asset_metric_timeseries_data_batch.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Arcana?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Arcana in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.
Arcana requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Arcana is developed by Arcana Analytics. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
